title: A replication study separates polymorphisms behind migraine with and without depression.
authors: Petschner, Peter; Baksa, Daniel; Hullam, Gabor; Torok, Dora; Millinghoffer, Andras; Deakin, J F William; Bagdy, Gyorgy; Juhasz, Gabriella
one_liner_zh: 该文为偏头痛与抑郁共病的遗传关联复制研究，基于GWAS位点与回归/贝叶斯/神经网络分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The largest migraine genome-wide association study identified 38 candidate loci. In this study we assessed whether these results replicate on a gene level in our European cohort and whether effects are altered by lifetime depression. We tested SNPs of the loci and their vicinity with or without interaction with depression in regression models. Advanced analysis methods such as Bayesian relevance analysis and a neural network based classifier were used to confirm findings. Main effects were found for rs2455107 of PRDM16 (OR = 1.304, p = 0.007) and five intergenic polymorphisms in 1p31.1 region: two of them showed risk effect (OR = 1.277, p = 0.003 for both rs11209657 and rs6686879), while the other three variants were protective factors (OR = 0.4956, p = 0.006 for both rs12090642 and rs72948266; OR = 0.4756, p = 0.005 for rs77864828). Additionally, 26 polymorphisms within ADGRL2, 2 in REST, 1 in HPSE2 and 33 mostly intergenic SNPs from 1p31.1 showed interaction effects. Among clumped results representing these significant regions, only rs11163394 of ADGRL2 showed a protective effect (OR = 0.607, p = 0.002), all other variants were risk factors (rs1043215 of REST with the strongest effect: OR = 6.596, p = 0.003). Bayesian relevance analysis confirmed the relevance of intergenic rs6660757 and rs12128399 (p31.1), rs1043215 (REST), rs1889974 (HPSE2) and rs11163394 (ADGRL2) from depression interaction results, and the moderate relevance of rs77864828 and rs2455107 of PRDM16 from main effect analysis. Both main and interaction effect SNPs could enhance predictive power with the neural network based classifier. In summary, we replicated p31.1, PRDM16, REST, HPSE2 and ADGRL2 genes with classic genetic and advanced analysis methods. While the p31.1 region and PRDM16 are worthy of further investigations in migraine in general, REST, HPSE2 and ADGRL2 may be prime candidates behind migraine pathophysiology in patients with comorbid depression.
abstract_zh: 最大的偏头痛全基因组关联研究确定了38个候选位点。在本研究中，我们评估了这些结果是否在我们的欧洲队列中在基因水平上得到复制，以及效应是否受到终生抑郁症的影响。我们在回归模型中测试了这些位点及其邻近区域的SNP，无论是否与抑郁症存在交互作用。使用贝叶斯相关性分析和基于神经网络的分类器等先进分析方法来确认发现。主要效应见于PRDM16的rs2455107（OR = 1.304，p = 0.007）以及1p31.1区域中的五个基因间多态性：其中两个显示风险效应（rs11209657和rs6686879的OR均为1.277，p = 0.003），而另外三个变异为保护因素（rs12090642和rs72948266的OR均为0.4956，p = 0.006；rs77864828的OR = 0.4756，p = 0.005）。此外，ADGRL2内的26个多态性、REST中的2个、HPSE2中的1个以及来自1p31.1的33个主要为基因间的SNP显示出交互效应。在代表这些显著区域的聚类结果中，仅ADGRL2的rs11163394显示出保护效应（OR = 0.607，p = 0.002），所有其他变异均为风险因素（REST的rs1043215效应最强：OR = 6.596，p = 0.003）。贝叶斯相关性分析确认了来自抑郁症交互结果的基因间rs6660757和rs12128399（p31.1）、rs1043215（REST）、rs1889974（HPSE2）和rs11163394（ADGRL2）的相关性，以及来自主效应分析的rs77864828和PRDM16的rs2455107的中度相关性。主效应和交互效应SNP均能通过基于神经网络的分类器增强预测能力。总之，我们通过经典遗传学和先进分析方法复制了p31.1、PRDM16、REST、HPSE2和ADGRL2基因。虽然p31.1区域和PRDM16值得在一般偏头痛中进一步研究，但REST、HPSE2和ADGRL2可能是伴有共病抑郁症患者偏头痛病理生理学的主要候选基因。
